title: Analytic Proof of a Quartic Continued Fraction Identity for $8/π^2$ via Operator Decoupling
summary: We present a rigorous analytic proof of a generalized continued fraction (GCF) identity for the transcendental constant $8/π^2$, a result recently conjectured via the algorithmic framework of the Ramanujan Machine. Distinct from canonical GCFs derived from classical hypergeometric series, the identity at hand features a complex polynomial architecture characterized by quartic partial numerators. Our approach utilizes an algebraic decomposition of the second-order shift operator $\mathcal{L} = \mathcal{T}^2 - b_n \mathcal{T} - a_n$ into a coupled first-order system.
